thread:
jules_fin: FYI sprout invoice SPR-9003 (01 May 2025) arrived with 0% VAT and a note 'OSS supplied'. No OSS number on invoice. Holding payment until we get proper OSS proof.

manish_ops: @jules_fin can you paste the invoice VAT note and invoice PDF link? I'll ask vendor to provide OSS registration and scope.

vendor_sprout: Hi all  thanks for flagging. We used OSS for EU B2C-facing digital services. Attached screenshot of our OSS portal and a partial export: https://files.vendor/sprout-oss-2025-05-01.png. Invoice header doesn't show OSS number 9. We can reissue.

jules_fin: The portal screenshot doesn't show a clear OSS registration number or country member state. Finance needs either: 1) reissued invoice with OSS registration number visible, OR 2) an export from the national OSS portal showing registration number + scopes, OR 3) statement from their tax agent confirming OSS registration.

tax_bot: Reminder: OSS is only valid for B2C sales; B2B parties should be invoiced net with reverse charge. If vendor mislabels B2B supply as OSS and leaves no OSS id, buyer may face recovery issues. Also require country code prefix on OSS id.

vendor_sprout: Understood. We can reissue invoice with OSS id FR-OSS-1234567 and add line: "OSS scheme: FR-OSS-1234567 9 supplies to EU consumers". Will that work?

jules_fin: That will work if the OSS id is genuine and matches the portal export. Please also confirm whether any line items were actually B2B (we have a contact email invoice-to@redwood.com). If any lines are B2B, don't use OSS for those.

manish_ops: Adding checklist for vendor: OSS registration number on invoice (pending), portal export showing id (pending), confirm B2B vs B2C split on invoice (pending). Payments: hold until docs received.

payments_bot: Payment hold placed on SPR-9003 (next run). Release will occur once finance confirms docs.

vendor_sprout: Sending reissued invoice with FR-OSS-1234567 and portal export now. Sorry for the oversight.

jules_fin: Received reissue + portal export. Verified FR-OSS-1234567 matches national portal export and all invoice lines are B2C. Processing payment in next cycle. Resolving thread. :white_check_mark:
